mainEntity.name: What kind of content does Generative Engine Optimization produce for pool contractors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generative Engine Optimization produces a diverse range of content types customized for pool contractors. This includes detailed service pages for pool design, construction, repair, and maintenance, blog articles discussing pool trends, maintenance tips, or material comparisons, and localized content targeting specific neighborhoods or cities. It can also generate FAQs, testimonials, and even social media posts, all optimized to resonate with your target audience and perform well on search engines.
